messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGE: Dedicated pool 'hotshot-42' hitting sustained p99 latency > 6s for streaming responses. Alert threshold breached at 3960012345. Auto-escalation to #incidents.
alex: saw the alert. p95 also creeping up. Confirming dashboards now.
maria: I'm on metrics. p95 for model-embed v2 is 1.1s but p99 is 6.8s and streaming stalls reported by a couple customers. Queue depth spike correlates with autoscaler events.
sam: paging oncall. @jordan you're primary right now — can you take?
jordan: taking. any customer-impact notes? which customers affected?
incident-bot: Affected routes (sample): redwood.api.generate_stream (tenant: marketing-toolkit), redwood.api.chat_stream (tenant: fintech-prod). Error/timeout rate unchanged; this is latency-only.
tanisha: I'm looking at pool telemetry. warmup success rate dropped ~40% during the burst, lots of pending warmups stuck in PROVISIONING state.
alex: logs show backlog growth around 3960012310. Autoscaler attempted scale-up at 3960012320 but new slots didn't become READY until ~3960012368.
maria: timeline summary for triage:
- 3960012308: sudden surge of traffic from marketing-toolkit (large prefix streaming workloads)
- 3960012315: queue depth jumps from 12 -> 240
- 3960012320: autoscaler requested +8 slots
- 3960012368: only +3 slots registered as ready (others failed warmup)
- 3960012375: p99 peaked at 7.2s, streaming stalls detected

sam: root cause hypothesis: dedicated pool saturation + delayed warmup due to heavy prefix cache population + hotshot scheduling backlog.
jordan: OK. immediate mitigations?
tanisha: we can force-fallback policy for affected tenants to smaller-sequence models or to shared-hosted tier while we resolve. I'm pushing a canary rollback to a smaller KV-cache profile for the pool to speed warmup.
alex: can we throttle marketing-toolkit at proxy for a short window to let warmups catch up? reduce their concurrency limit from 50 -> 5.
jordan: do it. sam, can you coordinate the proxy rule and notify SRE?
sam: on it. proxy rule:
```
PATCH /proxy/tenants/marketing-toolkit
body: {"concurrency_limit": 5, "burst_limit": 10, "reason": "emergency warmup backpressure"}
```
applied at 3960012380.
incident-bot: ACTION LOG: proxy throttle applied for marketing-toolkit by sam at 3960012380.
maria: post-throttle: queue depth reduced to ~60 within 20s, p95 dropped to 1.9s, p99 trending down to 3.5s. Warmup successes increasing.
tanisha: warmup failures looked like OOM on a subset of instances (insufficient GPU mem for larger KV cache). Switching to smaller cache profile for new nodes.
alex: started fallback routing for fintech-prod to hosted-tier at 3960012385 for affected sessions. That should avoid customer-visible stalls while we stabilize.
jordan: notify customer success for fintech-prod and marketing-toolkit. cc: ops and CS.
sam: paging CS: @cs-team heads up, affected tenants were briefly latency impacted; we've throttled marketing-toolkit and routed fintech-prod to hosted-tier. Will follow with RCA.
incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigations in place. On-call handoff to ops-sre for deeper root-cause and postmortem. Next oncall: @tanisha (ops-sre rotation) for 2hr hotfix window.
tanisha: I'll keep hunting for why autoscaler didn't get all slots ready. Initial clue: image pull timeouts for one AZ and a flapping nvlink driver causing retries.
maria: raw logs excerpt:
```
2026-04-05T12:32:10Z warmup: starting instance i-0abc
2026-04-05T12:32:23Z warmup: pull image failed: net/http: TLS handshake timeout
2026-04-05T12:33:00Z instance i-0abc joined but KV-cache load failed: out-of-memory
```
jordan: plan for next hour: 1) scale down marketing-toolkit throttle gradually 2) replace failing instance images and rotate AZs 3) increase warmup parallelism with smaller cache size 4) postmortem + customer comms.
alex: I'm drafting a short status for customers now. Will include ETA for full remediation and mention fallback to hosted-tier.
sam: also recommend an autoscaler guard: if warmup backlog > 100, limit new inflight warmups per AZ to avoid systemic overload. I'll open a ticket.
incident-bot: NEXT STEPS: create postmortem ticket #INC-396001 on the board; assign to tanisha and maria. Temporary mitigation logged. Incident will remain open until p99 < 1.5s for 30m and warmup failure rate < 5%.
jordan: thanks team. monitoring alerts adjusted downward; keep updates in this thread. :thumbsup:
alex: updating runbook with the temporary throttle procedure and image pull retry tuning.
maria: will export metrics and add to postmortem. grabbing traces for streaming stalls now.
sam: closing paging loop with PD. leaving the thread for handoff to tanisha and ops-sre. if anything spikes, re-ping @jordan.
incident-bot: Incident marked 'mitigated' at 3960012399 pending stabilization check."
